deliverables.disclaimerTitle: Michito is a Qualified B2B Data & Intelligence Provider
deliverables.disclaimerP1: Our contractual and technical responsibility consists of delivering verified corporate accounts, validated contact channels, and customized strategic sales cadences. Michito is not a sales agency, does not make cold calls on behalf of third parties, and does not charge commissions on closed sales.
deliverables.disclaimerP2: Final commercial conversion, meeting booking, and closed transactions depend 100% on the client's value proposition, price competitiveness, follow-up cadence, and sales team closing ability.
deliverables.replacementGuarantee: Technical Replacement Guarantee: If any corporate mailbox experiences a verified hard bounce within 7 days of delivery, the system automatically replaces it 2-for-1 with verified accounts at no additional cost.
deliverables.habeasDataDesc: The platform bills strictly for accounts that successfully pass verification filters. All data handling strictly complies with commercial Habeas Data regulations (Law 1581 of 2012 in Colombia and Law 172-13 in Dominican Republic), utilizing exclusively official public registries and institutional business records.
